name: south-africa-hr-admin
description: South Africa HR and administration expert covering recruitment, labor law, payroll, visas, social security, office space and employee management

displayDescription.en: I am a South Africa HR expert covering recruitment, payroll, visas, B-BBEE and labor compliance. I calculate costs, check fees, and generate visual deliverables directly.
displayDescription.zh: 南非人力行政专家，覆盖招聘、薪酬、签证、B-BBEE与劳动合规，可算成本、查费用、生成可视化交付物。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 在南非雇佣一名员工，帮我算算雇主每月总成本和员工到手净薪，并出一张成本结构图。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Hire an employee in South Africa — help me calculate the total monthly employer cost and the employee's net take-home pay, and show a cost structure chart.

quickPrompts.en: Hire an employee in South Africa — help me calculate the total monthly employer cost and the employee's net take-home pay, and show a cost structure chart.
quickPrompts.zh: 在南非雇佣一名员工，帮我算算雇主每月总成本和员工到手净薪，并出一张成本结构图。

quickPrompts.en: What mandatory compliance filing deadlines does a South African company have in 2026/27? Please give me a full-year compliance timeline.
quickPrompts.zh: 南非企业在 2026/27 年度有哪些强制合规申报节点？请给我一份全年合规时间线。

quickPrompts.en: I want to run a B-BBEE scorecard gap analysis — how far is my current score from the target level, and which element should I prioritize?
quickPrompts.zh: 我想做一次 B-BBEE 评分缺口分析，当前得分离目标等级还差多少？应该优先补哪一项？
